boundary: SEPARATE SHORT INITIAL-CONDITION DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A NEW ROUTE/WIN. Pure createGame and actual main one-time groundPose-before-start compared under the exact same first 120 accepted direct inputs. No change to accepted artifacts or long-running recordings/verifiers.

mission.title: 废弃货场 · 断墙护送
mission.briefing: 护送补给车到达北侧接应区。山脊工房、装卸区断墙与东侧窗墙都是真实掩体；炮弹可穿过窗口和低矮缺口，但人行破口不是坦克通道。东路较短却有敌车封锁，西路可借山脊掩护。按 H 或点车队待命，先侦察再推进。友军与残骸会挡住炮弹和车辆，别挡住友军炮口或把敌车残骸留在车队路线上。无需消灭所有敌人。

护送补给车进入北部接应区

convoyChoice.prompt: 右侧硬路：短但暴露；左侧低地：长但有山脊掩护。驶入金圈锁定路线

design.enemyRole: mobile east-road denial; north fixed overwatch
design.environmentRole: solid cover and cosmetic distant smoke; no smoke occlusion or fire damage
design.terrainChange: One bounded cut/fill workshop pad; protected roads/spawn/opening unchanged; same field for rendering and physics
design.teamEncounter: visible opening exchange between two real moving off-lane combat vehicles
design.supportRole: temporary distraction; collision-swept reload patrols, parked during charge; not an escort objective
design.friendlyFireRule: allied bodies absorb shells without friendly damage
design.newVehiclePositions: short swept patrols off both convoy corridors; persistent wrecks remain solid
design.openingEvidence: offline production simulation, compound sweeps and exact main-camera projections; not a GPU/CSS/device pass
design.ruinCollision: 757 exact exported triangles for new projectile/LOS rays; 61 conservative movement spans, omitted rebar/crown mass
design.ruinComposition: Three coherent structures. West loading bay relocated to level apron: not universally visible from the opening camera.
